newsitem.title: USA: Regent, Meditrust in finance pact.
newsitem.headline: Regent, Meditrust in finance pact.

text.p: Regent Assisted Living Inc said Wednesday that it has agreed to the principal terms of a $174 million financing arrangement with Meditrust, a healthcare real estate investment trust.
The financing consists of three credit facilities.
The first provides up to $100 million in sale/leaseback financing for communities currently under construction and for acquisition of new communities.
The second provides an additional $70 million in financing for future development and acquisition activities.
The third is a $4.5 million line of credit available primarily for development related expenditures, including site acquisition.
